_readme: Trusted Directory of official domains for frequently impersonated Israeli organizations. Only entries with verified=true can produce a 'matches official' verdict. Entries with verified=false are kept so lookalikes can still be caught, but a link to them is reported as 'can't verify' until someone confirms the domain from an official source.
